title: Agent Identity Token (AIT) Payload Schema
description: JSON Schema for the AIT payload. AIT is a profile of JWT (RFC 7519) defined by the Sovereignty Verification Protocol (SVP). Version 1.1.0-draft, corresponding to draft-bravo-svp-ait-spec-02 — adds the optional cnf (confirmation) claim for Bound AITs per RFC 7800 / RFC 9449 (see spec Section 4.5).

iss.description: Issuer. URI of the Agent Identity Registry (AIR) that issued this token. Per RFC 7519 §4.1.1.

org.description: SVP Extension claim. Registered organization identifier. Must resolve in AIR. Lowercase alphanumeric with hyphens.

agent_id.description: SVP Extension claim. Unique agent instance identifier within the organization namespace.

agent_type.description: SVP Extension claim. Declared agent class. Determines scope contracts and rate limits in AIR.

assurance.description: SVP Extension claim. AIT Assurance Level. Maps to NIST SP 800-63 IAL. AIT-0: self-issued. AIT-1: registry verified. AIT-2: organization verified. AIT-3: government validated (PIV/CAC/Login.gov). AIT-4: high assurance (IL4/IL5). Independent of credential binding (cnf) — see spec Section 5.

scope.description: Array of declared access scopes per RFC 8693. Format: action:resource. Edge validators MUST reject requests not covered by at least one scope value.

iat.description: Issued-at time. Unix epoch seconds. Per RFC 7519 §4.1.6.

exp.description: Expiration time. Unix epoch seconds. Per RFC 7519 §4.1.4. MUST be after iat.

jti.description: JWT ID. UUID v4 per RFC 4122. Per RFC 7519 §4.1.7. Used for revocation list matching.

nbf.description: Not-before time. Optional. Unix epoch seconds. Per RFC 7519 §4.1.5.

cnf.description: OPTIONAL. Confirmation claim per RFC 7800. Presence indicates a Bound AIT (spec Section 4.5); absence indicates a Bearer AIT. additionalProperties is false here deliberately — this schema only supports JWK-thumbprint confirmation (jkt), not the other RFC 7800 confirmation methods (jwk, jwe, kid), to keep the validator's job to one code path.

jkt.description: JWK SHA-256 Thumbprint (RFC 7638) of the public key this AIT is bound to. The edge validator computes the thumbprint of the key in the presented Proof-of-Possession JWT header and compares it to this value.
